THE MECHANISM, and it is an enumeration short by one rather than a wrong idea: judge_survey keeps a FLAT address-resolution rule on purpose, because it is the BERTH DOOR's mouth and 'at berth time every holding resolves by definition'; the PROMOTION sieve survey_holdings_resolve wraps it and filters through _resolves_to(address, ticket), because it 'alone stands downstream of a move'. There is a third mouth: deposit_survey calls validate_survey — the door's gate — and a deposit runs AFTER the build, which is the promotion side's stated condition word for word. So the deposit inherits a tolerance-free rule at the one moment the tolerance was written for.

THE READING A COUNT CANNOT GIVE, and the probe would have been a healthy-looking corpse without it. Over a clean corpus this watch's two counts read 0 and 0 whether the disposition is wired or reverted — permanently, under a carrier that looks fine. That is the aider-shim class exactly (a measured half structurally dead beneath a green surface), and the ticket's own carrier clause called for it at cast, before there was a probe to be wrong. So the probe asks the wire BEHAVIORALLY: it borrows a berth the door accepts as it stands, points one holding at an address git records as moved, and reads three things — the berth door still refuses it, the deposit's gate does not, and deposit_survey reaches its NEXT check. Measured red under a reverted disposition while both counts stayed at zero. Generalises: when a watch reports an ABSENCE of failures, ask what distinguishes its zero from a dead instrument's zero, and build that reading too.
